zh.summary: 修复已有插件配置异常导致其他插件更新失败，以及 GitHub 插件已是最新时重试仍报错的问题。
highlights: 更新检查区分原有异常与本次新增异常，避免无关插件层缺失时把成功的更新全部回滚。
保留更新目标加载检查和新增异常回滚；不会删除异常插件配置，也不会擅自启用已禁用插件。
GitHub 来源插件重复更新时核对远端提交，已是最新版本不再误报更新失败。
Windows 退出时若进程查询超时，使用已建立的应用进程组安全退出，避免误报新版本兼容性检查失败。
knownIssues: 已有异常插件仍需单独处理；本次修复不会宣称这些异常已经恢复。
内置官方 DSH 为 0.1.7-alpha.1；候选内核通道另行提供通过兼容验证的新版本。
upgradeNotes: 退出 Portable 后再升级，保留原 data 和 workspace。

en.summary: Fix unrelated existing profile faults rolling back successful plugin updates and false failures when retrying an already-current GitHub plugin.
highlights: Compare profile validation before and after updates instead of attributing unchanged unrelated faults to the updated plugin.
Retain target loading checks and rollback for newly introduced faults. Preserve existing configuration and disabled plugins.
Verify the remote commit when a GitHub update leaves the revision unchanged; confirmed current builds no longer report a stale-update failure.
If Windows process inspection times out during shutdown, close the already-owned application job to avoid falsely rejecting a working update.
knownIssues: Existing broken plugins still require separate attention; this fix does not claim to repair them.
The bundled official DSH is 0.1.7-alpha.1. The candidate core channel independently supplies newly qualified versions.
upgradeNotes: Exit Portable before upgrading and retain data and workspace.
